Qualifications Experience: Fresh graduate up to 2 years of hands-on experience in backend development. Databases: Hands-on knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and familiarity with NoSQL/caching solutions (e.g., Redis, MongoDB). Tools & DevOps: Proficient with Git/GitHub and containerization using Docker .
